directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Diesel 30 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/diesel-30-concrete-pump. Electric 80 prints a 110 kW motor. The rural pump is 17 kW and 5–8 m³/h. Diesel 30 is 4105 / 56 kW and 15 m³/h. Diesel 30 prints 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa, 60 m / 180 m and 2000 kg. Open /en/products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump/ before you write “diesel 30” on a small order. Write “diesel”, the engine or 17 kW rural line, maximum stone, required output and both distances. Order it when the drive is the tractor arrangement on that sheet, not when you wanted a 4105 diesel trailer. Without a supply for that motor, open a diesel page such as Diesel 120 or LZ-80 and read that page’s own cells. That set includes Diesel 30 through Diesel 120, LZ-60, LZ-80, Tractor-Driven 4100 and the rural 17 kW diesel pump. The rural diesel pump prints 17 kW, 5–8 m³/h, 15 MPa, 30–50 m horizontal, 10–30 m vertical, hopper 0.2 m³ and 800 kg. Tractor-Driven 4100 prints 40 kW, 6–12 m³/h, 15 MPa, 40–100 m / 15–45 m, aggregate 1–3 cm, hopper 0.25 m³, slump 180–220 mm and 1300 kg. The section title “Example - Pressure Drop in a Steam Pipe” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
